mapper.select: SELECT ID AS id, MEM_ID AS memId, CAL_TEXT AS calText, PLACE AS place, TYPE_CD AS typeCd, SHARING_CD AS sharingCd, STATE_CD AS stateCd, COLOR_TAG_CD AS colorTagCd, CAL_TYPE AS calType, TO_CHAR(CAL_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS calStart, TO_CHAR(CAL_END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS calEnd, TO_CHAR(CREATED_ON, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdOn, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_ON, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedOn FROM CALENDER WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALENDER ( ID, MEM_ID, PLACE, CAL_TEXT, TYPE_CD, SHARING_CD, STATE_CD, COLOR_TAG_CD, CAL_TYPE, CAL_START, CAL_END ) VALUES ( CAL_SEQ.nextval, #{memId}, #{place}, #{calText}, #{typeCd}, #{sharingCd}, '01STATE', #{colorTagCd}, #{calType}, TO_DATE(#{calStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(#{calEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
mapper.update: UPDATE CALENDER SET PLACE = #{place}, CAL_TEXT = #{calText}, SHARING_CD = #{sharingCd}, TYPE_CD = #{typeCd}, CAL_TYPE = #{calType}, CAL_START = TO_DATE(#{calStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), CAL_END = TO_DATE(#{calEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT ID AS id, MEM_ID AS memId, CAL_TEXT AS calText, PLACE AS place, TYPE_CD AS typeCd, SHARING_CD AS sharingCd, STATE_CD AS stateCd, COLOR_TAG_CD AS colorTagCd, CAL_TYPE AS calType, TO_CHAR(CAL_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS calStart, TO_CHAR(CAL_END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS calEnd, TO_CHAR(CREATED_ON, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdOn, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_ON, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedOn FROM CALENDER
AND ( MEM_ID = #{memId} OR SHARING_CD = '01CALSHARE' )
AND TYPE_CD = #{typeCd}
AND ( PLACE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CAL_TEXT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
SELECT ID AS id, CAL_TEXT AS calText, get_sub_code_name(CAL_TYPE) AS calType, get_sub_code_name(TYPE_CD) AS typeCd, CAL_START AS calStart FROM CALENDER WHERE CAL_START BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT BIZ_NO || '_' || LOGIN FROM USERS WHERE BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND STATUS_CD = '01ACTIVE'
